title: Education for Osteoporosis in Persons With Existing Fractures
brief_summary: We wish to investigate whether a weekly, 2½ hour group-based osteoporosis education intervention (the Osteoporosis Prevention and Self-Management Course), is different to one session course (1x 2½ hours) on osteoporosis knowledge, confidence to eat calcium-containing foods, confidence to exercise, and amount of exercise undertaken after three and nine months of follow-up in people aged over 50 years who have already had a bone fracture.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Presented to Modbury Hospital's Accident and Emergency Department with a new bone fracture

Exclusion Criteria:

* Residence in nursing home
* Fracture sustained in motor bike, push bike or motor vehicle accident
* Fracture sustained due to high trauma, such as fall from roof or ladder
* Dementia
* Inability to participate in group settings
* Inability to understand spoken English
* Inability to provide informed consent
* Pathological fracture
* Usual place of residence outside South Australia
